about: The mindserver contract tools/andy-tests (game-test, the andy MCP) and tools/test-world rely on. Frozen 2026-11-11 (bot-rebuild task 0.2) from laya-follow 04fc5d7: src/mindcraft/mindserver.js, src/agent/mindserver_proxy.js, src/agent/library/full_state.js, tools/andy-tests/lib/mind.js, session.js, runner.js, real.js. The new bot's harness (bot/src/harness) must serve exactly this; bot/test checks it against these files.

clientToServer.effect: server emits state-update to this socket every 1000 ms until it disconnects
the agent handles message as if `from` said it (a !command or chat for the command model); no ack
(re)start the agent's game connection; agents-status goes in_game true when it is back. Sent every 30 s by restartAgent after a world reset until in_game.

serverToClient.when: on connect and whenever an agent's status changes
every 1000 ms while a listener is connected; only agents in game are keys

idle: action.isIdle true exactly when no job, activity or chore holds the body (andy_wait_idle, wait idle steps); action.current is the action label while busy (e.g. action:layaMine) and Idle/Stopped/... when idle

files.bots/<agent>/memory.json: deleted by forgetAgent before a reset restart
files.bots/<agent>/logs/laya-<task>.jsonl: read by andy_logs and the scenario checks

launch.command: node main.js --profiles <profile...> from the repo root (tools/test-world/lib/bot.js botCommand)
env: SETTINGS_JSON (host, port, minecraft_version, mindserver_port, auto_open_ui merged over settings.js)
launch.stop: SIGINT to the process group; SIGKILL after 10 s
